title: Extender
text: Extend true duration of input, 1 input, 1 output; {External reset} specifies whether the block can be reset, {Extension Period} specifies a fixed number of time steps for extension and {Time steps for extension} specifies the number of time steps for extending the true. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: Input signal specified as boolean boolean

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: Output signal returns as boolean boolean

params.name: External reset
params.values: specify whether the block can be reset off (default) | on

params.name: Extension Period
params.values: specify a fixed number of time steps for extension Finite (default) | Infinite

params.name: Time steps for extension
params.values: specify the number of time steps for extending the true duration 3 (default) | boolean
